_comment: Single source of truth for every spoken line. tools/voice/gen_voice.py renders each entry to public/audio/vo/<id>.ogg. 'say' (optional) is a phonetic respelling for the speech synth; 'text' is what the subtitle shows.

lines.text: Good morning, Associates! Today is day four thousand, one hundred and twelve without a union. Have a compliant day!
Clearance, this is Steward. That's Fulfillment Center Seven. Every parcel on the continent goes through those docks.
So does the signal that runs Max Price's robots. We want it switched off.
Twenty years I worked that floor. Then they gave my job to a toaster with a smile.
Breach the dock gate and get our people to the front door. Your watch is paired to the charges. Plant them, stand clear, and squeeze.
Thirty seconds! Lock and load, Local 404. The picket line is moving!
lines.say: Thirty seconds! Lock and load, Local four oh four. The picket line is moving!

lines.text: And Clearance... everything must go.
Go, go, go! Clearance, you're on point!
Associates on the dock. Mind the smiles. They mean it.
MonoMart ships more guns than groceries. Help yourself. Consider it back pay.
That parcel locker still has power. Somebody's order is about to go missing.
Container yard. Lots of corners. Keep your people moving.
Courier drones! Eyes up!
Delivery drones, inbound. They're fragile. Sign for them with a bullet.
The dock gate is sealed, and the override is on Price's side of it.
Two power couplings, one either side. Stick a charge on each, back off, and use the watch.
Charges on the couplings, Clearance. The yellow boxes.
One down. Now the other.
Ha! Now that is collective bargaining!
Gate's open. Lovely work.
Motor pool ahead. Take the Teamster. She's ugly, but she's union made.
Or borrow one of their delivery scooters, if you've no dignity whatsoever.
I've got the gun! You drive!
Punch it!
Attention, valued trespasser. This is Maxwell Price, founder and chief executive of MonoMart.
You are in violation of our terms of service. A representative will be with you shortly... to kill you.
Roadblock. Go through it or go around it. I'd go through it.
That's the front door. And that... is a Regional Manager.
I am the Regional Manager. I have reviewed your performance. It is... unsatisfactory.
The armour's too thick from the front. Get behind it and hit the cooling unit on its back.
Your position... has been eliminated.
Manager's down! Somebody tell corporate!
You're in. Outstanding. Catch your breath, Clearance. Sortation is next, and it's worse.
Enjoy your visit. Everything in this building is priced to move. Including you.
Clearance? Clearance! Somebody get them back on their feet.
On your feet, Clearance. The shift isn't over.
Consider that a written warning.
You're hurt, Clearance. Find cover.
Oh. Now that is not on the standard price list.
You're out of charges. Scrounge some more.
We've lost Strikers. Don't waste what they bought you.
Any time you like, Clearance.
The revolution will not wait for you to finish sightseeing.
New objective on your watch.
Attention shoppers: there are no shoppers. Thank you.
Reminder: unionizing is a class A felony, and also rude.
MonoMart. The only store. Because we bought the other ones.
Associates are reminded that smiling is mandatory.
Today's special: everything. Everything is the special.
Clean up on aisle... all of them.
If you see something, buy something.
Welcome, valued customer!
No refunds. Ever.
Thank you for funding both sides of this conflict!

ally._comment: Rendered once per voice: ids are <voice>_<group>_<n>.

crash: Easy! I've got a pension to collect!
idle: Twenty years of service and I got a pizza party.
Remember when stores had people in them?
My knees were not built for revolution.

alert: Can I help you find... the exit?
attack: Please remain calm during your termination.
This will only hurt until it stops.
hurt: Your feedback is important to us!
That is not covered by warranty!
mine: That is not on the manifest!
flee: I don't get paid at all for this!
Taking my break! Taking my break!
lost: Must have been a pricing error.
cover: Taking cover! As per the handbook!
vehicle: Slow down in the parking lot!

alert: I will handle this one personally.
attack: This is going on your permanent record!
shield: My shield! That is company property!
hurt: You will pay retail for that!
death: I want... to speak... to my manager...
rally: Back to work, all of you!
Hold the line or you are all recycled!

attack: Let's circle back... to hurting you.
hurt: That will come out of your budget.
death: This... will reflect poorly... on the quarter...
